meta.title: refactor: move processNode to main process
meta.body_summary: Move processNode function from renderer to main process to prevent UI blocking, add WebviewUpdate IPC interface, and batch webview updates.

perf_labels.notes: Devin refactor to move processNode to main process; closed by maintainer after 16 minutes with no review or comment explanation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 397 changed lines across 7 files, this is a small to medium refactor by absolute volume. The change concentrated in the AST engine (197 lines) and a new main process handler (151 lines). As an architectural offload performance PR it was closed without merge; no review feedback recorded, so outcome is not clearly related to change scale.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or human comments; PR closed by maintainer without explanation.
review_details.performance_claim: Moving processNode to main process via IPC prevents UI blocking by offloading compute from renderer.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by maintainer (Kitenite) with no comment; no review activity. Presumed maintainer did not want the change or it conflicted with other plans.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Electron process boundary refactor; PR was closed without review, illustrating that maintainer acceptance may require pre-alignment on architectural changes, not just code correctness.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after UI responsiveness metrics provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix-in-PR cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Move processNode from renderer-side AST engine (apps/studio/src/lib/editor/engine/ast/index.ts) to main process (apps/studio/electron/main/events/ast.ts) with IPC via WebviewUpdate interface; update callers in tailwind input and chat context, and register new handler in main process runners.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Packages models constants adds a new IPC message constant.
change_trajectory: Single commit refactoring: moved processNode to main process, added new IPC events, updated all callers, and added WebviewUpdate interface.
